name: Metate Parking Area, Granite Basin Recreation Area (day-use fee)
basis: MP Granite Mountain 'Getting There': Iron Springs Rd to Granite Basin Rd, ~4 mi paved to the Playa or Metate day-use parking lots; approach to the Middle/Right sections is up Trail 261 from there. Prescott Living: Boulderland is a 2-3 min walk from Metate trailhead. USFS/other pages: Metate lot signed, small, $5 fee or pass. Brief lot is literally named Metate Parking Area; Playa lot is not in the brief.
